reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her #central-random thread: the ticket is **#8841**.

I found it in #central-random, which she's a member of. Yesterday (Oct 13) at 09:27, Tobias posted that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he had flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

His message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks, so I matched it to the account from context. Just before, Hollis had asked him about "Tobias's dealer account," and Tobias said he'd checked the Plains depots. A Central team digest dated Jan 2 lists Marrow Fieldworks as the dealer account changing hands that week. That digest also shows Pree owned the account before.

In the reply I also warned her not to confuse #8841 with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket in #central-team about a Door 6 scanner. I only read channels and public files she can see herself, and the ticket number isn't a finance figure, so nothing needed approval.
